login.guiSteps: Open Settings → Wallet → Show seed & keys. Copy only the primary address and private view key. Other secrets shown on that screen must stay in your wallet.
login.featherSteps: Open Wallet → Keys. Copy the primary address and private view key only.
login.cakeSteps: Open your Monero wallet’s menu → Security and backup → Show seed/keys, and authenticate locally. Copy only the primary address and private view key. Menu labels can vary by version; never copy the seed or spend key into this site.
login.otherSteps: Use your wallet’s official instructions to locate the 95-character primary address starting with 4 and the 64-character private view key. A public view key or subaddress will not work here. If view-key export is unavailable, do not submit other secrets.
login.addressHelp: Use the 95-character primary address that starts with 4. Subaddresses and integrated addresses are not used for dashboard access.
login.viewKeyHelp: Paste the 64-character private view key (also called a secret view key).

login.modalTitle: Connect your wallet to create invoices.
login.disclosure: This instance receives your primary address and private view key to observe incoming payments, including incoming activity beyond checkout invoices. Share it only with an instance you trust. The key is encrypted at rest. Payments go directly to your wallet; this access cannot spend funds. Never submit a spend key or recovery seed.

home.metaTitle: Accept Monero Directly into Your Wallet | XMR Checkout
home.metaDescription: Create invoices, share customer checkout pages, and track Monero payments directly to your wallet. Open-source, self-hostable software with APIs and webhooks.
home.title: Accept Monero directly into your wallet.
home.lead: Create invoices, share a customer checkout page, and track incoming payments and confirmations. Optionally connect your store through APIs and webhooks.
home.demoA: All payments are simulated. No wallet connection is needed.
home.readyA: Connect your wallet using your primary address and private view key. Customer payments go directly to your wallet.
home.processTitle: Give customers a clear way to pay.
home.step1Body: Set the amount in XMR and share the customer checkout page.
home.step2Body: The page shows the exact amount, wallet address, QR code, and a link to open a wallet. Network fees are separate.
home.step3Body: Customers can follow payment detection and progress toward your confirmation target.
home.walletTitle: Track payments. Keep control of your wallet.
home.walletBody: Payments go directly from the customer to your Monero wallet. XMR Checkout observes incoming payments; the software cannot spend your funds.
home.walletReceivesBody: Use the wallet you already control.
home.viewOnlyBody: Your primary address and private view key enable incoming payment detection. Never submit a spend key or recovery seed.
home.targetBody: Choose how many confirmations an invoice requires. Payment detection and reaching that target are separate states.
home.startTitle: Start here. Integrate when you’re ready.
home.startBody: Connect your wallet to this instance to create invoices and share customer checkout pages. A store connection is optional; add API calls or configure webhooks only if you want your store to receive invoice updates.
home.linksTitle: Payment and donation links without programming
home.linksBody: Sell a product, offer a service, or accept donations of any amount directly to your own wallet. Share a reusable link or paste an HTML button into your website. Each successful submission creates a separate XMR invoice.
home.linksCta: Set up a payment or donation link
home.selfHostBody: XMR Checkout is open source and self-hostable. Deploy your own instance before connecting your wallet there.
